reviews.title: Looks great with great performance
reviews.comment: I bought this to replace my Arctic Freezer 3, as I wanted to change some aesthetics to my computer and the Freezer 3 doesn't look as good. It was easy to install the cooler and uses a USB-C connection for the display. it comes with multiple faces, but the LCD display is the only reason to buy this. The pump and defaults fans are quieter than Arctic and looks much better with the LCD display. With the Freezer 3 I had to lower the pump speed in BIOS to keep it quiet, but this is quiet by default. As for performance, the cooling is roughly the same but it just has a very beautiful LCD display and it was easy to change the pump cover. It was a different software than the MasterHUB, so I will need two software to power both cooler master items, wish it was both software, but the software works as intended Overall, it has a great build quality that elevates your computer build while keeping your CPU cool.
reviews.author: Andrew

reviews.title: Buen rendimiento, pero problemas con el RGB en mi unidad
reviews.comment: El rendimiento térmico es bueno, pero tuve inconvenientes con la iluminación RGB. En mi caso, el bloque de ventiladores presentó un comportamiento irregular en el RGB. Los colores no se sincronizan correctamente y cambian de forma inesperada al intentar controlarlos con software como SignalRGB o RGB Fusion. Probé diferentes configuraciones y conexiones ARGB, pero el comportamiento se mantuvo, por lo que parece estar relacionado con la unidad que recibí. La pantalla LCD funciona correctamente, pero la iluminación del bloque y los ventiladores no ofrece el nivel de control que esperaba. Si la iluminación RGB es un aspecto importante para ti, recomendaría tener en cuenta este punto antes de comprar.
reviews.author: John Rojas

reviews.title: Excellent cooler, mid software.
reviews.comment: Just to start off, just like any other LCD/Oled screen on an aio cooler. It uses cpu resources. About 4-5% of my 7800x3d while running the software so I feel like that could fixed/tuned a bit. I also wish you had more customization within the software like being able to rotate the screen less than the limited 90 degrees at a time as this is the only way the cooler would mount correctly so the lines wouldn't bind up or look wonky. With the software open my cpu runs 48c with it closed or in offline mode it runs at 40c. Do with that what you will. As for the cooler and pump, excellent. Very silent fans and pump while keeping it cool and looking good. If they fixed the software and made it more adjustable I would give this a 5/5.
reviews.author: Jonny
